# Bundled presentation assets

These static assets are bundled so the admin UI works without a CDN connection.

- Bootstrap 5.3.3: MIT license, copied from its npm distribution.
- Bootstrap Icons 1.11.3: MIT license, copied from its npm distribution.
- DM Sans variable Latin normal font: SIL Open Font License, copied from the `@fontsource-variable/dm-sans` npm distribution. The local CSS retains the existing DM Sans family and uses `font-display: swap`.

License files are retained beside each asset. No Bootstrap JavaScript is required; dashboard interactions use the existing vanilla JavaScript.
